Track server-side values

Source: R/track.R
snap_track.Rd

Registers a reactiveValues object so that snap_take() captures its fields (all of them, or the ones named in fields) under name in the snapshot's values section, and so that a restore can write them back.

Usage

snap_track(
  values,
  fields = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

values

A reactiveValues object.

fields

Names of the fields to capture, or NULL for all fields.

name

The name to store the values under. Defaults to the name of the variable passed as values.

session

The Shiny session. Defaults to the current session.

Value

The (namespaced) name the values are stored under, invisibly.

Details

Inside a module, name is namespaced automatically.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  library(shiny)

  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    prefs <- reactiveValues(digits = 3L, scientific = FALSE)
    snap_track(prefs)
  }
}
